method: Rows show measured intraday changes around a dated communication. A single day can contain a statement, conference, and overlapping full-meeting window.

Quote midpoints shown in Eastern time. The provider uses medians of ten-minute quote samples centred on each endpoint and can extend a sample for illiquid instruments. Other simultaneous news can affect the measured move.
USMPD interest-rate changes are converted from percentage points to basis points. Equity and FX percentages retain the original scale. EUR/USD and USD/JPY have different base currencies.

Cash S&P 500 returns require both ten-minute quote samples inside the NYSE session, accounting for holidays and early closes. The workbook can report carried or displaced cash-index prices outside the session.

Group comparisons exclude unscheduled FOMC communications. Each stage is analysed separately. A minutes release carries its own publication date. Minutes require an exact same-day match in the Board publication calendars. Original workbook dates without that confirmation are listed in unmatchedMinutes and excluded. Only release rows with a scored original statement carry a guidance score.

assets.label: S&P 500
assets.description: Cash index return. A positive value is an equity gain. Both quote intervals must be inside the NYSE cash session.

assets.label: US 2Y Treasury
assets.description: Change in the benchmark two-year Treasury yield.

assets.label: US 10Y Treasury
assets.description: Change in the benchmark ten-year Treasury yield.

assets.label: US 2s10s
assets.description: Change in the ten-year yield minus the two-year yield. Positive means steepening.

assets.label: USD 1Y OIS
assets.description: One-year overnight indexed swap rate. An increase implies a higher rate over this horizon.

assets.label: EUR/USD
assets.description: US dollars per euro. Positive means euro appreciation against the US dollar.

assets.label: USD/JPY
assets.description: Japanese yen per US dollar. Positive means dollar appreciation against the yen.

assets.label: US dollar index
assets.description: Dollar index return. Positive means broad dollar appreciation against its currency basket.

assets.label: S&P 500 E-mini futures
assets.description: Front-contract futures return. Trading hours differ from those of the cash index.

assets.label: Next meeting · fed funds futures
assets.description: Change in the fed funds rate expected for the next scheduled meeting. For minutes this refers to the upcoming decision.

assets.label: Current meeting · fed funds futures
assets.description: Current-meeting target surprise inferred from fed funds futures. Minutes have no current decision.

assets.label: US 5Y Treasury
assets.description: Change in the benchmark five-year Treasury yield.

assets.label: US 30Y Treasury
assets.description: Change in the benchmark thirty-year Treasury yield.

assets.label: US 5Y real yield
assets.description: Change in the yield of the benchmark five-year inflation-protected Treasury.

assets.label: US 10Y real yield
assets.description: Change in the yield of the benchmark ten-year inflation-protected Treasury.

assets.label: US 5Y inflation compensation
assets.description: Nominal five-year yield change minus the TIPS yield change. Includes inflation risk and liquidity premia.

assets.label: US 10Y inflation compensation
assets.description: Nominal ten-year yield change minus the TIPS yield change. Includes inflation risk and liquidity premia.
